actions: Source and approved stageA design read only.No edits,compile,tests,native helper,GUI,event posts,process probes,TCC/lock/keepawake actions.Only this exclusive0600 review JSON written.Parent-reported clang warning-clean compile is not an independently executed review result.
scope: StageA passive own-window balanced middle/button2 receiver only.Not a rescue,held-state test or input injector.Production source/default-off/native capture qualification remain unchanged.FullP5 remains in_progress.

confirmedFindings.title: Layer-zero scan can falsely report an unobscured own hit
confirmedFindings.source: State iterates CGWindowList front rows but skips every nonzero kCGWindowLayer before choosing the first containing rectangle.
confirmedFindings.failure: A floating/system overlay above the pad with a nonzero layer is ignored,so hit can be true even though actual mouse hit would not reach the pad.Production PointGuard explicitly uses NSWindow.windowNumberAtPoint to cover these overlays;fixture witness is weaker.
confirmedFindings.impact: Incorrect predispatch own-window hit evidence and misleading armed admission.Production guard may still refuse before posting;this is not a confirmed production misdispatch.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use actual AppKit windowNumberAtPoint:belowWindowWithWindowNumber:0,require exact own window number and ownerPID,then record the actual hit identifier.Keep production AX/point guard independent;do not infer overlay absence from layer0 geometry only.

confirmedFindings.title: Journal is not byte-bounded and command backlog is unbounded
confirmedFindings.source: getline allocates an unlimited command line;every command enqueues an asynchronous main block without a pending limit.state.request and rejected.op are copied unchanged into rows.Serial256 caps write count only,not bytes per row;receipts cap does not bound caller-controlled fields.
confirmedFindings.failure: A single large state.request/rejected.op can create arbitrarily large allocations/journal row before serial reaches256;many queued commands can consume unbounded memory despite eventual journal count failure.
confirmedFindings.impact: Does not satisfy approved bounded journal/control design;receiver can stall or die instead of preserving a failure witness.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Bound input bytes before full line allocation,validate command keys/types and small scalar request IDs,apply a fixed serialized-row plus cumulative-journal byte limit,and cap pending main commands/backpressure reader.Fail closed without terminating a potentially non-neutral receiver.Example bound choices must be frozen with harness;record explicit capacity failure,not silent truncation.

confirmedFindings.title: stdout pipe loss defeats the stated EOF keepalive path
confirmedFindings.source: Emit uses puts/fflush on stdout with default SIGPIPE behavior and no return/error checks;stdin EOF merely leaves NSApp running.
confirmedFindings.failure: If the external reader/runner closes pipes or dies,an input or later report written to the closed stdout pipe can raise SIGPIPE and terminate the receiver while non-neutral,despite stdin EOF not explicitly calling terminate.
confirmedFindings.impact: The passive witness is not reliably kept alive on control/observation channel loss.Receiver never posts input,so this is a witness/cleanup robustness defect,not a rescue guarantee.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Ignore SIGPIPE before reporting;detect write/flush errors and disable failed stdout/report the channel fault to its independent journal without recursion.Continue own observation and safe-neutral lifecycle;never emit input or blanket cleanup as fallback.Harness must treat channel loss as failure and only reclaim birth-verified receiver after neutral.

confirmedFindings.title: Malformed PID command can crash the receiver
confirmedFindings.source: arm invokes intValue on command.pid before validating that it is an integral nonboolean NSNumber in pid_t range;an array/dictionary/NSNull can reach the message under otherwise valid neutral/nonce preconditions.
confirmedFindings.failure: JSON with valid arm nonce and pid:NSNull/array sends unsupported intValue selector and can raise an Objective-C exception instead of an explicit rejection.
confirmedFindings.impact: Malformed own control traffic can destroy passive evidence and the non-neutral-safe lifecycle contract.Caller is a private harness,so no external remote attack claim.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Validate exact command shape and pid NSNumber type,exclude booleans/nonfinite/fractional values,require2..INT_MAX,and only then convert.Require a wellformed nonempty birth string and validate before state changes.Malformed commands must record bounded rejection rather than crash.

fixtureHarnessContractConditions.source: arm is permitted again after disarm,including the same case nonce;down/up counts and receipt list are reset.No everArmed/usednonce set,arm monotonic timestamp,expiry or frozen frame/point/TIS snapshot.
fixtureHarnessContractConditions.required: For the designed one-pair fixture,prefer exactly one successful arm and fixed bounded acceptance interval,with arm snapshot/time retained.Reject reused/replayed nonce.Ensure events are not accepted merely because they were delivered after arm when their source timestamp predates it.Harness must retain all arm/disarm attempts and require exactly one genuine interval.

fixtureHarnessContractConditions.area: Meaning of matched and exact point/source/state
fixtureHarnessContractConditions.source: matched checks armed/journalOK,button2/down-up order and sourcePID+current process birth only.It does not check planned point,zero event flags,expected interval,unchanged frame/front/hit/TIS or complete paired40ms shape.State and raw flags/point/timestamps are nevertheless recorded.
fixtureHarnessContractConditions.required: Either include frozen arm conditions in matcher or define matched narrowly as emitter/order only.Harness MUST separately require both event receipts at exact planned point,flags0,proper timing,stable owned frame/front/hit/TIS,expected native worker birth from real native receipt,and postpair HID/combined neutral.No matched-only success predicate.If sourcePID does not actually identify native emitter,fail attribution rather than time-proximity substitute.

fixtureHarnessContractConditions.area: Durability acknowledgement versus pre-fsync row field
fixtureHarnessContractConditions.source: row.journalOK=true is serialized before write/fsync.A subsequent fsync failure turns stdout row false and disarms,but a complete-looking disk line may retain true;row.armed also reflects pre-failure state.
fixtureHarnessContractConditions.required: Normal stdout successful Emit occurs after fsync and can acknowledge the raw row.If any write/fsync/channel error occurs,fixture/harness must mark whole run failed/unconfirmed even if disk row says true.Require post-fsync positive ACK/exact sequence or final healthy seal in addition to raw journal;do not infer durability from pre-write disk journalOK alone.Consider making commit acknowledgement semantics explicit in field names and correcting output armed state on failure.

fixtureHarnessContractConditions.source: Immediate parent lstat checks owner/private nonsymlink,then journal path and parentFD are opened separately.No identity comparison binds those handles against a parent rename/replacement race.
fixtureHarnessContractConditions.required: StageA harness must supply and retain exact fresh private root identity.If adversarial/replaced-root refusal is claimed,use parent dirfd+openat with identity checks.This fixture is not a general hardened multiuser journal service;no such broad acceptance should be inferred.

positiveAssessment: No event creation/posting APIs,no clipboard writes,no TIS switching,TCC requests/revoke,lock action,notification center or historical Shift/left recovery appear in this source.It creates/activates its own plain blue titled window as intended;reviewer did not execute it.

Own-window sendEvent records and swallows middle down/up and other own input without entering text/control/menu behavior.No user text is captured.Event receipt includes actual raw sourcePID,current Birth(pid),CG/NSEvent timestamps,button,flags,global point and match flag.

Birth uses proc_pidinfo start seconds+microseconds.Saved expected birth is checked again per received event,so PID-only identity is not the acceptance mechanism.Receiver self PID/birth/PPID/PGID/SID and window identity are reported.

State reads HID and combined buttons0..2,any key0..127,relevant generic/device modifier bits,actual current TIS id/type,frontmost and CG owner/frame.Those are useful observations;aggregate state is not per-hardware ownership evidence.

Journal file creation uses exclusive create,no-follow,append,close-on-exec,0600;immediate parent must be owned/private directory;directory fsync attempted and each normal complete line write retries EINTR then fsyncs before stdout report.Receipts and journal row count have finite caps,though byte/control limits in BR2 are missing.
stdin EOF does not directly terminate NSApp,quit requires Neutral and not armed,disarm requires Neutral,and journal failure disarms without posting input.No unqualified rescue is attempted.
qualificationLimits: This is static source review;no proof of runtime middle-event sourcePID,AX hit,neutral observations,TIS stability,actual file mode/fsync errors or pipe-loss handling was executed.
No held input fault may run from this review.Existing aggregateHID/sourcePID cannot guarantee external mouse-up hardware noninterference.No independent rescue exists or is qualified here.
Do not kill receiver/root in cleanup while actual input is non-neutral;ordinary scheduled up and production finally/watchdog need chance to settle.No automatic retries or fallback release.

Harness remains under implementation and needs its own independent source review/freeze,including exact one admitted provider list_windows->macro pair path,permission/delivery/effect audit and cold no-replay.Compile success alone is not acceptance.
requiredBeforeProceeding: Repair BR1-BR4 and define/implement BC1-BC3 exact acceptance contract;preserve reviewed v1 findings/bytes binding.
Independent static rereview of changed fixture and complete harness,then frozen serial normal stageA qualification by authorized owner with no native/GUI concurrency.
Retain default-off/fullP5open/no-held/no-lock-no-revoke/no-physical-demo and all original10+4 plus background/API0/resume/CLI/manual/schema/retention requirements.
